attempts.summary: Configured node1 (AlmaLinux 9) to require new user passwords to be at least 12 characters with at least 3 character classes, via a libpwquality drop-in (/etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/90-antrieb-policy.conf with minlen=12, minclass=3) enforced through the existing pam_pwquality entries in system-auth/password-auth. Verified enforcement end-to-end via real passwd/PAM flow (short and low-diversity passwords rejected, compliant password accepted). Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id/uptime/config/service baseline, issued a background `reboot`, polled until exec access returned, confirmed boot_id and boot timestamp changed, and re-verified the policy file persisted and PAM enforcement still worked correctly post-reboot.
